meta.title: The Shop Trophy
meta.subtitle: Five stations. Five parts. They bolt together and you take it home.

sections.blurb: Read this once. It is the same at every station.
sections.title: How it works

blocks.title: Watch. Plan. Cut.
blocks.content:
**Watch** your station's video before your rotation opens. Not at the machine.

**Plan** in your notebook before you touch anything. Five questions, below.

**Cut** with the video playing. Your partner holds the phone. You run the machine.

**No plan, no machine.** Your notebook gets checked before you start.

### Two classes per station

Your group gets two class periods at each station. In those two periods, **every person in the group leaves with their own part.** How you get there is up to the group.

Five rotations. Five stations. Five parts. They assemble into your trophy.

sections.blurb: One per part, on paper, before you make it
sections.title: The drawing

blocks.content:
You get the model file for each part. Before you make that part, you draw it on paper.

**The standard: someone who has never seen the model could make the part from your drawing.** Every dimension needed to manufacture it. Every feature. If something is missing, they would have to guess, and a guess is a wrong part.

You will end the unit with five drawings, one per part.

blocks.title: Draw one rotation ahead
blocks.content:
Draw your first part in class before the rotations start.

After that, you draw the **next** rotation's part while you are at your current station and not on the machine. That is what the waiting time is for.

### The topper is different

There is no model for the topper. You design it yourself in the xTool software. Two rules:

- **2 inches maximum** width or diameter
- **A 1/4 inch hole dead center**

Everything else is yours. Sketch your design on paper first, same standard as the others.

sections.blurb: In your notebook, before every station
sections.title: The five plan questions

blocks.content:
Same five questions at every station. Write them in your notebook before you start.

**1.** What am I making? Sketch it with the dimensions.

**2.** What are the steps, in order?

**3.** What tool and what settings for each step?

**4.** Where do I stop and measure?

**5.** What is most likely to go wrong here?

sections.blurb: You need one. These are the rules that come with it.
sections.title: Phones at the machines

blocks.title: One holds the phone, one runs the machine
blocks.content:
- **Never the same person.** The person running the machine does not touch the phone at any point.
- The phone stays **off the machine and out of the hazard area.** Never on the table, the ways, or inside the enclosure.
- You should be able to **turn your head and see it.** If you have to lean, reach, or step to see it, move it.
- Phones come out for the station video and **nothing else**, at any point in the block.

**Base**, plywood, cut and engraved on the H2D laser. Your name goes on it. Add a logo or an image if you have time.

**Column**, aluminum box tube, squared up on the mill, then two holes: one tapped 1/4-20, one 1/4 inch through.

**Platform**, polycarbonate, cut on the Axiom CNC router.

**Shaft**, hex stock, turned on the lathe, tapped 1/4-20 at both ends, rounded on one end.

**Topper**, steel, cut on the xTool MetalFab. Your design.

All the threads are 1/4-20.
